Maya Chen: quick heads up — pushed a tiny followup to PR #3456: moved the error normalization into a helper and fixed the nil-case we missed. addressed Jordan's comments and renames. PTAL when you get a sec: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/3456
Jordan Patel: looking. i'll run tests locally first, but this diff looks small.
ci-bot: [ci/circleci] queued for: PR #3456 (build triggered)
Jordan Patel: small nit — prefer `normalize_err` -> `normalize_error` for readability, otherwise looks good. left an inline comment. also can you add a 1-line unit test for the nil path?
Maya Chen: good call, done. added test and renamed the helper. pushed -> force-pushed with commit 7bd3f2. snippet of test added:
```python
def test_normalize_error_none():
    assert normalize_error(None) == ""
```
Samir Rao: PTAL from QA side after CI. if green i can own the merge + canary. ping me when checks pass. :+1:
Leo Nguyen: quick doc nit in the function docstring, not blocking. canary window works for me tomorrow 10:00am PST if we want to roll then.
ci-bot: [ci/circleci] build passed — all tests green for PR #3456
Jordan Patel: approved. :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: thanks all. assigning merge owner to @Samir Rao. scheduling canary per Leo's window.
Samir Rao: I'll merge once the repo merge-bot picks up approvals. planning canary rollout at 2026-03-21T17:00Z (UTC). leaving a quick checklist in the PR description for post-merge smoke checks.
merge-bot: merge queued — awaiting final pod-sanity and canary schedule.
Maya Chen: noted. if anything pops during canary i'll open a rollback PR and notify #incidents.
Samir Rao: merged into canary branch — rollout scheduled. thanks everyone. :tada:
